topography.project_purpose: AI Agents. Structurally: 53 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 9 ERC20 tokens, 3 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 10 functional families. Its contracts share 11 common project-authored base contract(s) (oftcore, oapp, oappsender). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
